variant_intent.row: row (default, main action on the left)

a11y.fact: The button types render a role="group" container; callers name it with aria-label (spread onto the div).
The button types compose the native Button, so each action is a real <button> with its visible text as its accessible name.
The segmented type renders a role="radiogroup" container; callers name it with aria-label.
Each segment is a native <input type="radio"> inside a <label>, all sharing one name, so exactly one is selected and arrow-key behaviour is the browser's own; aria-pressed is not used.
The radio input is transparent (not display:none), so it stays focusable and exposed to assistive technology while the label draws the segment.
Keyboard focus on a segment shows the browser's native focus ring on its label, via :has(input:focus-visible).
